digest.component_or_area: store path resolution and sidecar directory management
propositions: Five modules independently derive the sidecar directory path for a store tracker, leading to repeated unresolved-symlink bugs across separate tickets
Centralizing sidecar and git directory path derivation into a frozen StorePaths class ensures consistent symlink resolution at a single ownership point
A guard test must enforce that no module outside paths.py computes .rebar-joined paths for sidecars, with escape-marker control to exempt necessary cases
Symlinked worktrees sharing one store must resolve all sidecar artifacts to identical canonical paths under the single .rebar directory
Existing call sites already apply symlink resolution compositely, so consolidation preserves behaviour while preventing latent divergence
